resolvedFindings.fix: Preserve an existing stage-error file and emit the new refusal on stderr; both refusal cases must exit 1 with prior run/error bytes unchanged.

resolvedFindings.after: refuter-guard-02.json: 2/2 error and run records byte-identical, refusal stderr retained, both exit 1; no child or network calls.
